claims: The Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego on Friday, April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT), completing a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission goal was a successful flyby of the moon, testing systems for future lunar landings.
The Artemis II mission had identified issues with the heat shield.
NASA successfully managed a modified re-entry for the Artemis II mission.
NASA and U.S. military teams recovered the Artemis II crew following splashdown
